issue.name: Path traversal
issue.issueBackground: Path traversal vulnerabilities arise when an application uses user-controllable data to access files on the filesystem.
issue.issueDetail: By requesting the URL /cgi-bin/.%2e/.%2e/etc/passwd, the server returned the local password file.
issue.remediationBackground: Upgrade the underlying web server to a secure patch release.

issue.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) not enforced
issue.issueBackground: Content Security Policy is an effective defense against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
issue.remediationBackground: Configure a valid Content-Security-Policy HTTP header on all responses.
